title: Balla
extract:
The Balla is a  Puncture-focused bladed Strike used in Zaw construction.

Acquisition
The Balla blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostrons and buying it from Hok for  1,000.

Characteristics
This Strike primarily deals  Puncture damage.

5%  Impact
60%  Puncture
35%  Slash
Compatible weapon types:

Dagger
Staff

Trivia
Should the player wish to name their weapon with the word 'Balla', as per the strike's name, the game will not let the player do so as it is considered profanity. Zaws created shortly after the release of Update 22.0 (2017-10-12) can have that name before the game's profanity filters were updated.
